meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索网页并提取链接内容,快速获取技术资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在研究或开发中快速获取网页和论文内容。
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and extract page content to get technical info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly gather web pages and papers for work or study.

howto.what: 接入 Exa 后，Claude 能用关键词加语义检索做联网搜索，也能按你给的网址抓取网页、文章或学术 PDF 的正文，一次可抓多个链接。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索、查资料、找最新信息，或给出网址让它抓取、提取文章内容时接管；学术检索可加研究论文类别。

say.text: 帮我搜一下近两年关于钙钛矿太阳能电池的研究
把这篇 arXiv 论文的正文抓下来
say.note: 走 Web Extract 提取 PDF 内容

say.text: 搜索时只限 nature.com 和 arxiv.org

howto.what_en: With Exa wired in, Claude can run web searches and fetch content from URLs you give it — webpages, articles, or academic PDFs, several at once — with optional filtering toward research papers.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask it to search, look something up, fetch a page, or extract an article; scholarly lookups can set the research-paper category.

say_en.text: Search for recent studies on perovskite solar cells.
Fetch the full text of this arXiv paper.
say_en.note: Runs Web Extract on the PDF.

say_en.text: Search but limit results to nature.com and arxiv.org.
